Diploperennis NILs: SNP50K against the production run

RTIGER ancestry from the SNP50K calls and from production run 1367152’s counts (genome fit, 1 Mb rigidity; ancestry jobs 1387871, 1388677; 2026-10-17)

Author

Fausto Rodríguez-Zapata

Published

October 17, 2026

Per donor, the same lines in the same order in each block: SNP50K RTIGER calls on top, zealgt below. zealgt here is RTIGER on the counts of variant-calling production run 1367152, fitted per donor over the whole genome at 1 Mb rigidity (ancestry jobs 1387871, 1388677). zealgt, wideseq: the same fit on only the markers whose position, REF and ALT are in the wideseq teosinte-vs-B73 panel (bzeaseq/wideseq_ref; filter job 1389323). 6 donors, 253 lines.
